Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI

Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

## Playground by Google Labs

Launching today

Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI [...] Report

 285 views

Justin Jincaid

GNGM

Hunter

📌

Google just launched Playground, and this looks pretty fun. You can describe a game idea in plain English, and Google's AI turns it into something you can actually play in your browser. Want to change the rules, characters, or physics? Just ask. You can also share your games, publish them for others to play, and even create multiplayer experiences. The interesting part is that Google is also working with Unity to bring more advanced game creation into Playground. Curious to see what people come up with when making a game becomes this easy.

FunBlocks MindMax is centered on structured thinking rather than an open-ended canvas, which makes it a strong alternative when clarity and decision-making matter more than freeform ideation. While Google Mixboard 2.0 emphasizes turning boards into presentations, MindMax emphasizes guiding the thinking process so the content is stronger before it becomes a deck.
